text.zh_cn:
被火焰熏烤过的苹果，甜得像最后的晚餐。
- 食用 [item:minecraft:apple] 恢复 4 点饥饿值
- 橡树落叶中偶尔能找到它：[block:minecraft:oak_leaves]
> 不死人靠它撑过了最初的夜晚。
text.en_us:
An apple kissed by fire, sweet as a last supper.
- Eating [item:minecraft:apple] restores 4 hunger
- Found among fallen oak leaves: [block:minecraft:oak_leaves]
> The undead survived their first night on these.
